brautarholt-golf-club.label: Open Brautarholt’s 18-hole diagram guide
brautarholt-golf-club.scope: Individual diagrams and playing notes for holes 1–18, published by Golfklúbbur Brautarholt.

bro-hof-slott-stadium.label: Open the Stadium Course map and hole diagrams
bro-hof-slott-stadium.scope: The Stadium Course overview includes a full routing map and individual hole diagrams; it is separate from the Castle Course.

cog-hill-no-4-dubsdread.label: Open Dubsdread’s official course layout
cog-hill-no-4-dubsdread.scope: A full routing illustration for Course No. 4 — Dubsdread, alongside its course tour and scorecard.

jack-s-point.label: Open Jack’s Point’s official routing map
jack-s-point.scope: The club’s golf page includes a full routing illustration with holes numbered 1–18.

katameya-heights-golf-tennis-resort.label: Open the Championship Course scorecard and local rules
katameya-heights-golf-tennis-resort.scope: The 18-hole Championship Course scorecard gives yardages, pars and stroke indices, not a routing diagram. The separate New Nine card is also on the page.

kyt-j-golf-south-east.label: Open South East’s 18-hole diagram guide (Finnish)
kyt-j-golf-south-east.scope: Start at hole 1 and use the numbered links for all 18 South East hole diagrams, with distances and playing notes in Finnish; this is not the North West course.

montgomerie-maxx-royal.label: Open Montgomerie Maxx Royal’s course map
montgomerie-maxx-royal.scope: The Championship Course page includes the full routing map and a link to its hole-by-hole schematics and videos.

royal-cape-golf-club.label: Watch Royal Cape’s official hole flyovers
royal-cape-golf-club.scope: The club’s course page provides hole-flyover videos, not a static routing map.

royal-golf-marrakech-old-course.label: Open Royal Golf Marrakech’s course map (image)
royal-golf-marrakech-old-course.scope: The map marks the Old Course’s 18 holes in red and the separate New Course’s nine holes in blue. Follow the red numbering for the Old Course.

sentosa-golf-club-serapong.label: Watch the Serapong’s official 18-hole video tour
sentosa-golf-club-serapong.scope: Individual videos and descriptions cover Serapong holes 1–18; this is not the Tanjong course.

steenberg-golf-club.label: Explore Steenberg’s official hole photos and flyovers
steenberg-golf-club.scope: The club’s hole-by-hole guide combines photographs, playing notes and flyovers for its 18-hole course.

thai-country-club.label: Watch Thai Country Club’s official 18-hole video tour
thai-country-club.scope: Videos cover holes 1–18 and are labelled by the club as footage from the 2022 Aramco Team Series Bangkok.

tpc-summerlin.label: Explore TPC Summerlin’s featured holes 15–18
tpc-summerlin.scope: Photographs and descriptions cover only holes 15–18, not a complete 18-hole routing map or yardage guide.

walton-heath-golf-club-old.label: Open Walton Heath Old’s routing map and scorecard (PDF)
walton-heath-golf-club-old.scope: The club’s December 2024 Old Course men’s scorecard includes a numbered 1–18 routing map as well as hole yardages. It is not the New Course card.
